answer: A jade of per-task receipts records who did what, and the signal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a academic prose with citations to prior work register, it stays short. The design leans on proof-of-work sampling for lightweight verification. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The cedar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
